supersededAttempt.reason: All four API shards exited at the first stale transaction double they reached, each one a fixture that had stopped modelling a delegate production genuinely calls: a raw-query renderer that knew only tagged templates, and transaction doubles that entered terminalizeUndeliveredCurrentWork without owning conversationTurn/conversationTurnStartupFragment. The first error in each shard masked the rest of the same family. Product bucket, tenant, SHA, zero-skip and database safety semantics remain strict; the immutable EXITED 1 attempt is stale audit history only.

retryBudgets.rationale: An EXITED attempt ran the command and its exit code is the product's answer; retrying it would turn one criterion into best-of-N. The other four types end the attempt without producing an answer, so a bounded retry weakens no evidence. Attempts a04bd84d and e7c287ae each burned the full 3600s deadline on 2026-08-31 and wrote zero bytes under host starvation, spending a formal attempt each for nothing.

timeoutCalibration.method: timeoutSeconds >= ceil(observedMaximumSeconds * marginFactor); the declared value is max(minimumTimeoutSeconds, that floor rounded up to quantumSeconds). Nodes with no completed observation keep their prior declaration and are listed in unobservedNodes. The four Full API shards partition one case set, so each carries the whole family's ceiling. Durations come from 164 release DAG node receipts; the one TIMED_OUT receipt (prepare-build, 958.9s under host starvation) is excluded because a run killed by its own timeout never reported how long it needed.
